data.gender_notes: Haddal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root h-d-d meaning 'give'. In Islamic tradition, Haddal symbolizes the concept of giving and generosity. It is a name for a child who is expected to grow up to be a giver, spreading kindness and compassion to those around him. The name Haddal carries the meaning “Generous Gift” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haddal usually hope their child will grow to embody generous gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haddal total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
